metric_note: Primary metric follows the ICSE 2025 paper: edge coverage = number of distinct control-flow transitions covered during fuzzing, measured via AFL's afl-showmap (unique edge count). Report median over 5 repeats for every (program, fuzzer) cell in the full 21×10 grid. Compare all assisting exploration strategies (dictionary, SMT, gradient, input-to-state) under identical 24-hour budgets.
